title: ARRI Alexa 35 Cinematic Large-Sensor
purpose: Industry-standard cinema production with organic skin rendering, gentle highlight roll-off, and 17 stops of dynamic latitude.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: Super 35 format ALEV 4 CMOS with 17 stops of exposure latitude
sensor_and_optics.lens: Cooke S4/i 50mm T2.0 Cine Prime ('The Cooke Look')
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: EI 800 base sensor sensitivity with ARRI LogC4 color science
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 17 stops of total dynamic range with unmatched highlight retention
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electronic rolling shutter with 180-degree cinema shutter angle (1/48s equivalent motion cadence)

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Cinematic soft key through 8x8 diffusion frame with black solid negative fill
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Organic volumetric light falloff, gentle halation around specular light sources, filmic shadow contrast

surface_rendering: Authentic dermal subsurface scattering, soft organic skin texture with natural pore definition without video edge-enhancement
Cooke optical character: gentle warmth, creamy skin rendering with crisp central resolution
Subtle optical halation and low-contrast shadow details without digital noise smearing
depth_and_optics: Smooth cinematic depth of field roll-off characteristic of cinema prime lenses
Round, organic out-of-focus background elements without polygonal aperture artifacts
Zero breathing, clean rectilinear optical projection

execution_directive: Enforce high-end feature film cinematic capture. Deliver ARRI LogC4 tonal gradation, organic skin tones, Cooke optical warmth, and natural motion cadence.
